proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 708, what are the minimum dimensional requirements for a stairway serving a Group A dwelling?

options.text: 750 mm minimum clear width, with maximum 200 mm riser height and minimum 200 mm tread run
900 mm minimum clear width, with maximum 180 mm riser height and minimum 250 mm tread run
600 mm minimum clear width, with maximum 250 mm riser height and minimum 250 mm tread run
1,000 mm minimum clear width, with maximum 150 mm riser height and minimum 300 mm tread run

proposed.rationale: Section 708 requires stairs serving Group A dwellings to have at least 750 mm clear width, with risers not exceeding 200 mm and treads of not less than 200 mm run. The dimensions support safe, comfortable ascent and descent for a single residential occupancy.
proposed.explanation: These three values are commonly tested as a set; the 750 mm / 200 mm / 200 mm stair rule is the Section 708 baseline for Group A dwellings and should not be confused with the wider or shallower dimensional sets required for assembly or institutional occupancies.
